_about: French's worked examples of the Coderack and temperature, transcribed as data from F95 pp. 77, 81, 90-93 (the tables and formulas read on the page images). Every number is as printed; print slips are recorded beside the arithmetic. Cited from SPEC.md sections 5 and 6; checked by tests/test_worked_examples.py.

temperature_exponent.law: linear in the temperature between those two points
temperature_exponent.print_slip: p. 93 prints 0.4 for find-neighbor's chance at a = 1; the table of p. 77 and the arithmetic give 0.3

urgency_explosion.as_described: reduced in one instant to approximately one-quarter of its previous value

generations.print_note: 12.5 is 4 of 32; the competing codelet's share of 4 + 32 is 11.1 percent

coderack_capacity.removal: the oldest are pushed off; no removal by urgency [F95 pp. 76-77]

worldview_oscillation.note: two equally good rivals alternately winning; small changes in quality, many changes in composition

temperature_formula.formula: T = alpha * dQ / Q + beta * dWV - gamma * Tcp
temperature_formula.constants: alpha, beta, gamma positive; beta and gamma chosen so that dQ/Q dominates

chapter_4_final_rack.note: each bar measured against the 23 evenly spaced labels (item 05, docs/ch4-run.md); the same numbers are in ch4.json
